changes: Files for the same month now add up: upload October 1–15, later October 16–31, and the month fills in. Your changes are kept.
Holidays & suspensions: set a holiday, class suspension or vacation once for everyone, a category (e.g. Teaching) or chosen employees.
Longer remarks (up to 48 letters, e.g. TRAVEL TO MANILA FOR SEMINAR) now print in full — long ones print smaller.
A cleaner Settings window with a menu on the left; the Employee List now fits on the screen.
